notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Next Message Request implementation to the exact C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies the official signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors, including a filesystem report that preserves the supplied request boundary when a queued message produces an earlier grant, the bounded timestamped-save admission boundary, a saved-pending NMR restore under both callback models, and regional interaction and object-attribute TSO callback frontiers before the ordinary grant. It is not catalog evidence, protected-review evidence, package support, or a conformance claim.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void nextMessageRequest( LogicalTime const & time) = 0
